items.text: Identify the report as a systematic review.
Structured abstract following the PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts list.
Rationale for the review in light of existing knowledge.
Explicit objectives or questions the review addresses.
Inclusion and exclusion criteria, and how studies were grouped.
All sources searched, with the date each was last searched.
Full search strategies for every database, with filters and limits.
How records were screened: reviewers, independence, automation tools.
How data were collected: reviewers, independence, confirmation, automation.
Outcomes for which data were sought, and how results were chosen.
Other variables sought, and assumptions about missing information.
Risk of bias methods: tools, reviewers, independence, automation.
Effect measure used for each outcome.
How studies were judged eligible for each synthesis.
Data preparation for synthesis, such as missing data and conversions.
Methods to tabulate or display individual and synthesised results.
Synthesis methods and rationale; model, heterogeneity, software.
Methods to explore causes of heterogeneity.
Sensitivity analyses assessing robustness of the synthesis.
Methods to assess risk of bias from missing results.
Methods to assess certainty in the body of evidence.
Search and selection results, ideally with a flow diagram.
Near-miss studies that were excluded, with reasons.
Each included study cited, with its characteristics.
Risk of bias assessments for each included study.
Per-study summary statistics and effect estimates with precision.
Characteristics and risk of bias of studies in each synthesis.
Results of all statistical syntheses, with precision and heterogeneity.
Results of investigations into causes of heterogeneity.
Results of sensitivity analyses.
Risk of bias from missing results, for each synthesis.
Certainty of evidence for each outcome assessed.
General interpretation of results against other evidence.
Limitations of the evidence included.
Limitations of the review processes.
Implications for practice, policy and future research.
Registration details, or a statement that it was not registered.
Where the protocol can be accessed, or that none was prepared.
Amendments to registration or protocol, with explanation.
Financial and non-financial support, and the funders' role.
Competing interests of the review authors.
Availability of forms, extracted data, analysis data, code, other materials.
